data.title: 平冢静 · 客厅沙发落肩卫衣的微醺轻叹
data.description: 深夜温暖的单身公寓客厅内，矮桌上摆着已喝空的啤酒罐。平冢静穿着舒适宽松的花灰廓形大卫衣与居家短裤，侧身歪靠在柔软的沙发扶手旁。宽大的卫衣领口自然滑落一侧，露出白皙性感的香肩与优美锁骨。微醺的酒意染红了成熟英丽的面颊，她以单手托腮，眼波迷离地注视着眼前，展露出平日难以见到的可爱娇嗔与成熟女性的微叹。
data.location: lived-in cozy bachelor apartment living room with empty beer cans on table
data.action: 穿着舒适宽松的花灰廓形大卫衣与居家短裤
data.lighting: warm dim floor lamp casting rich amber hues across living room
data.promptProse: In a warm late-night apartment living room with empty beer cans resting on the coffee table, Shizuka leans sideways against the sofa armrest and props her flushed cheek in her palm. Her eyes look soft and tipsy as she pouts toward the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Slouched against her apartment sofa armrest beside empty beer cans on the low table, she rests her cheek in one hand with a tipsy flushed pout as her oversized grey sweatshirt slips off one bare shoulder.
data.nsfwProse: Her oversized heather-grey sweatshirt hangs loosely off one shoulder to reveal her collarbone and bare shoulder above casual lounge shorts and bare legs.
